name: MPI Sintel Optical Flow Benchmark
description: MPI Sintel is an optical flow evaluation benchmark derived from the open-source 3D animated short film Sintel. Providing dense ground-truth optical flow, camera motion, and depth under realistic rendering conditions including specular reflections, motion blur, and non-rigid physical deformations.

publisher.name: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems
